offering_description.value: ITT designs and manufactures fluid handling and processing equipment, motion and suspension components, and electrical interconnects and controls. It supplies standard and custom equipment to industrial manufacturers, energy operators, transportation companies, and aerospace and defense customers. It also provides process engineering and aircraft wiring repairs.

quotes.quote: ITT is a diversified leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions for the transportation, industrial, and energy markets.
We produce our wide range of innovative products and solutions through three operating segments: Flow Technologies, Motion Technologies, and Connect and Control Technologies.

Since the debut of the first all-metal pump the pump engineers at ITT Goulds Pumps have worked closely with industries worldwide to develop the innovative pump products and technologies required by their demanding applications. ITT Goulds Pumps is a world leader in hydraulics, materials science, mechanical design, fluid dynamics and green energy – with extensive experience in nearly every type of driver, bearing, seal, piping and nozzle configuration, flange and baseplate design to meet most pump application needs in sectors including chemical, food & beverage, industrial process, mining, oil & gas, and power generation.

primary_services.value: Process engineering and pilot testing; aircraft wiring harness repair

quotes.quote: Seital develops precision separation and clarification technologies for dairy, beverage, pharmaceutical and industrial manufacturers. The portfolio combines advanced centrifugal separation systems, engineering expertise and process knowledge to improve product quality, maximize product recovery and optimize operational efficiency. Supported by Innovation Center capabilities, pilot testing and comprehensive lifecycle support, Seital Separation helps manufacturers evaluate, scale and optimize processes while delivering reliable long-term performance.

Co-Operative Industries Aerospace and Defense (CIA&D) manufactures electrical wiring harnesses, ignition leads and flexible metal conduit for the commercial airline and defense industries. In addition to manufacturing capabilities, CIA&D’s on-site FAA & EASA certified Repair Station supports major airlines and Maintenance, Repair, and Overhauls (MROs). With quick turnaround time and cost effective electrical harness repairs, CIA&D saves maintenance operators both time and money.
